pr001-peitoral-dorsal.name: Chest/Back PR001
pr001-peitoral-dorsal.shortDescription: Professional equipment for chest and back exercises. Reinforced steel structure with anatomical padding.
pr001-peitoral-dorsal.description: The Chest/Back PR001 is professional equipment developed to work the pectoral and dorsal muscles with maximum efficiency and safety. It features a carbon steel structure with electrostatic paint and anti-corrosive treatment, ensuring durability and resistance. The anatomical padding injected in Naval PV Crom provides superior comfort during exercises, being anti-allergic, washable and antifungal.

pr002-polia-superior-remada.name: High Pulley with Row PR002
pr002-polia-superior-remada.shortDescription: Versatile equipment combining high pulley and rowing. Robust structure for complete pulling exercises.
pr002-polia-superior-remada.description: The High Pulley with Row PR002 offers total versatility for pulling exercises, combining high pulley and rowing in a single equipment. Developed with robust steel structure and premium finish, it provides safe and efficient movements for developing back, shoulder and arm muscles.

pr003-multi-press.name: Multi Press PR003
pr003-multi-press.shortDescription: Multifunctional equipment for press exercises. Ergonomic design for maximum efficiency and safety.
pr003-multi-press.description: The Multi Press PR003 is designed to offer multiple press exercise options in one equipment. With ergonomic design and reinforced structure, it allows safe and efficient exercises for developing chest, deltoid and tricep muscles, ensuring versatility and performance in your training.

pr004-biceps-triceps.name: Biceps/Triceps PR004
pr004-biceps-triceps.shortDescription: Specialized equipment for biceps and triceps exercises. Precise biomechanical movements for maximum muscle development.
pr004-biceps-triceps.description: The Biceps/Triceps PR004 was specifically developed to provide high-quality exercises for arm muscles. With precise biomechanical movements and ergonomic adjustments, it offers efficient muscle isolation for biceps and triceps, ensuring balanced and safe development.

pr005-leg-press-hack.name: Seated Leg Press with Hack PR005
pr005-leg-press-hack.shortDescription: Robust equipment for leg press and hack squat exercises. Versatile design for complete leg development.
pr005-leg-press-hack.description: The Seated Leg Press with Hack PR005 combines two fundamental exercises for leg development in one robust equipment. It offers ergonomic positioning for both leg press and hack squat, providing versatility and maximum efficiency in lower limb training.
pr005-leg-press-hack.cardName: Seated Leg Press with Hack PR005

pr006-cadeira-adutora-abdutora.name: Adductor/Abductor Chair PR006
pr006-cadeira-adutora-abdutora.shortDescription: Specific equipment for leg adduction and abduction exercises. Precise and comfortable movement.
pr006-cadeira-adutora-abdutora.description: The Adductor/Abductor Chair PR006 offers specific and isolated exercises for the adductor and abductor muscles of the legs. With precise adjustments and controlled movement, it provides efficient strengthening of the inner and outer thigh muscles, essential for stability and athletic performance.

pr008-leg-press-hack-squat.name: Leg Press Hack Squat PR008
pr008-leg-press-hack-squat.shortDescription: Professional equipment for leg press and hack squat. Design optimized for intense lower limb training.
pr008-leg-press-hack-squat.description: The Leg Press Hack Squat PR008 was designed to offer maximum versatility in lower limb exercises. It combines the functionality of leg press with hack squat biomechanics, providing complete and intense training for quadriceps, glutes and hamstrings with safety and efficiency.

pr009-cross-over-angular.name: Angular Cross Over PR009
pr009-cross-over-angular.shortDescription: Cross over tower with advanced angular design. Multiple exercise options with dual pulleys.
pr009-cross-over-angular.description: The Angular Cross Over PR009 represents the state of the art in cross over equipment. With innovative angular design and dual pulley system, it offers infinite exercise possibilities for all muscle groups. Ideal for functional training and complete muscle development.

pr010-multi-station.name: Multi Station PR010
pr010-multi-station.shortDescription: Complete multifunctional station for gyms. Multiple exercises in one compact equipment.
pr010-multi-station.description: The Multi Station PR010 is the complete solution for gyms seeking versatility and space efficiency. This multifunctional equipment offers a wide range of exercises for all muscle groups, allowing complete and varied workouts in a single compact and robust station.

pr013-banco-uni-inclinavel.name: Uni-Adjustable Bench PR013
pr013-banco-uni-inclinavel.shortDescription: Bench with unidirectional adjustment for free weight exercises. Compact and resistant design.
pr013-banco-uni-inclinavel.description: The Uni-Adjustable Bench PR013 offers the versatility needed for free weight exercises at different angles. With precise unidirectional adjustment and compact structure, it is ideal for chest, shoulder and other muscle group training that requires stable and adjustable support.

pr015-cadeira-extensora-flexora.name: Leg Extension/Curl Chair PR015
pr015-cadeira-extensora-flexora.shortDescription: 2-in-1 equipment for leg extension and flexion exercises. Precise biomechanics for quadriceps and hamstrings.
pr015-cadeira-extensora-flexora.description: The Leg Extension/Curl Chair PR015 combines two fundamental exercises for lower limb development. With precise biomechanics and ergonomic adjustments, it allows isolated exercises for both quadriceps (extension) and hamstrings (flexion), ensuring balanced and safe leg development.

privacy.description: Power Run privacy and data protection policy
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

general.title: 1. General Information
general.content: Power Run is committed to protecting the privacy and personal data of our users, customers and website visitors. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, store and protect your personal information in compliance with the General Data Protection Law (LGPD) and other applicable legislation.

dataCollected.title: 2. Data Collected
dataCollected.intro: We may collect the following types of information:

items.provide: Provide information about our products and services
items.support: Provide technical support and customer service
items.legal: Comply with legal and regulatory obligations

sharing.title: 4. Data Sharing
sharing.content: We do not sell, rent or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes. We may share information only when necessary to comply with legal obligations, provide requested services or protect our legitimate rights.

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure or destruction. We use encryption, access controls and other appropriate security technologies.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies
cookies.content: We use cookies to improve your browsing experience, analyze website traffic and personalize content. You can configure your browser to refuse cookies, but this may affect some website functionalities.

contact.title: 8. Contact
contact.intro: To exercise your rights or clarify questions about this policy, contact us:

changes.title: 9. Policy Changes
changes.content: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically. We recommend that you check this page regularly to stay informed about any changes. The date of the last update is indicated at the beginning of this policy.
